info.name: Ride Hailing Platform - Evaluation Collection
info.description: Evaluation collection for required ride-hailing microservice endpoints. Set {{BASE_URL}} to the service host:port before running each request group (for example user service, driver service, ride service, payment service).

request.description:
Create rider via POST /v1/riders.

Example body:
{
  "name": "Alice Rider",
  "email": "alice.rider@example.com",
  "phone": "9000000001",
  "city": "Bangalore",
  "password": "alice@123",
  "role": "rider"
}

Expected response shape (201):
{
  "id": 101,
  "name": "Alice Rider",
  "email": "alice.rider@example.com",
  "phone": "9000000001",
  "city": "Bangalore",
  "role": "rider",
  "created_at": "..."
}

Fetch rider by id via GET /v1/riders/:id.

Expected response shape (200):
{
  "id": 101,
  "name": "Alice Rider",
  "email": "alice.rider@example.com",
  "phone": "9000000001",
  "city": "Bangalore"
}

Create driver via POST /v1/drivers.

Example body:
{
  "id": 2001,
  "name": "Bob Driver",
  "phone": "9111111111",
  "email": "bob.driver@example.com",
  "vehicle_type": "Sedan",
  "vehicle_plate": "KA01AB1234",
  "is_active": true,
  "city": "Bangalore",
  "password": "bob@123",
  "role": "driver"
}

Expected response shape (201):
{
  "id": 2001,
  "name": "Bob Driver",
  "is_active": true,
  "vehicle_type": "Sedan",
  "vehicle_plate": "KA01AB1234"
}

Create trip via POST /v1/trips.

Example body:
{
  "rider_id": 101,
  "pickup_location": "BTM",
  "drop_location": "HSR",
  "distance_km": 8,
  "city": "Bangalore"
}

Expected response shape (201):
{
  "id": 501,
  "rider_id": 101,
  "trip_status": "REQUESTED",
  "distance_km": 8,
  "surge_multiplier": 1.2
}

Charge payment via POST /v1/payments/charge.

Example body:
{
  "trip_id": 501,
  "rider_id": 101,
  "amount": 136,
  "idempotency_key": "501"
}

Expected response shape (201 or 200 replay):
{
  "id": 701,
  "trip_id": 501,
  "amount": 136,
  "status": "COMPLETED",
  "idempotency_key": "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555"
}

Fetch Prometheus/OpenMetrics text from user service /metrics.

Expected response shape:
# HELP metric_name ...
# TYPE metric_name counter|gauge
metric_name value

Set {{BASE_URL}} to driver service base URL, then call /metrics.

Expected response shape:
# HELP metric_name ...
# TYPE metric_name counter|gauge
metric_name value

Set {{BASE_URL}} to trip service base URL, then call /metrics.

Expected counters include:
trips_requested_total
trips_completed_total

Set {{BASE_URL}} to payment service base URL, then call /metrics.

Expected counters include:
payments_failed_total

Set {{BASE_URL}} to rating service base URL, then call /metrics.

Expected gauge includes:
avg_driver_rating
